lines.l: But I just can't convince myself I couldn't live with no one else
And I can only play that part And sin and nurse my broken heart
So lonely, so lonely, so lonely
Now no one's knocked upon my door
For a thousand years or more
All made up and nowhere to go
Welcome to this one night show
Just take a seat, they're always free
In this desert that I call my soul
I always play the starring role
